notes: Account summary: large EU-based legal-tech marketplace building a cross-lingual enterprise search layer for contracts, judgments, and precedents. Heavy multilingual needs (EN/FR/DE/ES/IT/PT/PL/RO + RU/AR/ZH for partner markets). Primary goal: unify retrieval across languages and surface high-precision results per locale.

Current infra: customer runs proprietary ES for metadata + Postgres for indexing; evaluating hybrid vector + sparse pipeline. Dataset size ~120M docs (indexing split: 85M short docs/35M long docs). Embedding dim target: 1536 for dense vectors, experimenting with 768 for some locales to reduce cost.

Scale & perf targets: ~150 qps baseline, peak 400 qps for batch re-index windows; 95th percentile end-user latency target: 180-250ms for first-pass ANN retrieval (per-lang), 350-450ms end-to-end with cross-encoder reranking for short queries; max acceptable cross-encoder latency for long queries 800ms (they want <700ms ideally). Cost sensitivity: target <$0.015 per query avg (all-in).

Retrieval & rerank strategy discussed: two-stage pipeline — FAISS/IVF-PQ or HNSW for first-pass with per-language shards; cross-encoder reranker for top-10 re-ranking. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization profiles and batching to hit latency/cost targets.

Multilingual tuning requirements: need per-language recall/precision baselines (dev sets provided), support for cross-lingual embeddings so EN queries can retrieve FR/DE documents without translation step. Concern: recall drop in low-resource languages (PL/RO) and morphological languages (RU/AR). Request: per-language eval harness + automated regression alerts on recall metrics.

Security & compliance: must store vectors in EU region, KMS integration for key management, audit logs for every inference and admin action, SSO via SAML. They will run Private with control plane in our infra but VPC peering required. Air-gap for some customers is a future ask (not now).

Pilot / POC plan: Redwood to provision dedicated cluster (8xA100 equivalent) + private control plane in eu-west-1. POC tasks: import sample 10M doc subset by 2026-03-22, run baseline embeddings (m-1536), build per-language ANN indices, run recall/precision suite, tune PQ/quantization to hit cost/latency targets, test cross-encoder rerank latency at 200 qps simulated traffic.

Quotes & pricing: sent initial pricing deck 2026-02-12 (link above). Customer asked for committed monthly pricing for Dedicated plus one-time migration support. Procurement expects a SOC2/ISO addendum for contract.
Customer quotes: 'We need predictable p50/p95 across languages — can't have EN performant and everything else degraded.' — Head of Search (call 2026-02-14).

Internal notes: SE Priya ran initial microbenchmarks: FAISS IVF-PQ + 8-bit quant gives 2.3x cost reduction but p95 increases ~40ms. Cross-encoder (mT5-large) at 10-steps re-rank is borderline for ru/zh long docs; recommend Redwood Optimize suggestions and try causal cross-encoder pruning + kernel selection. Assigned RWD tickets for infra config (RWD-3421) and eval harness upload (RWD-3580).
